text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Switzerland autonomously introduced, and incorporated into national law through the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade, the «Cassis de Dijon principle»", "gist": "Switzerland adopted the Cassis de Dijon principle into its national law via the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "a product which complies with the technical regulations of the EU, a member state of the EU or that of the EEA, and is legally placed on the market in one of these member states, may in principle be placed on the Swiss market without any further controls (art. 16a of the Law on Technical Barriers to Trade)", "gist": "Products meeting EU/EEA member state regulations can be sold in Switzerland without additional checks"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Law on Technical Barriers to Trade", "gist": "Swiss law that includes the Cassis de Dijon principle"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Cassis de Dijon principle", "gist": "Legal principle allowing free movement of goods meeting EU/EEA standards"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Negative List (PDF, 193 kB, 01.01.2025)", "gist": "Link to a PDF document titled Negative List with size and date"}]}
